title: Church news: writing a post on the phone
question: The last one. Staff and ministry leaders write posts on the phone and in the admin panel with the same editor (the admin panel gets a wider version of whichever you pick). Pictures, video, audio and files upload through the outbox, so a post can be written offline and sends when the phone is back online. How should writing one feel?

options.label: Who, when and telling first, then the words
options.thesis: One page in grouped settings: who it's for, the notification (on, with its words and Urgent), when, then the title and the text with a format bar and an Add button for pictures, video, audio and files.
materials: Cancel and Post at the foot
options.viewport: New post: Who it's for (Everyone), Tell people with the notification on, When (Now or Later), then the post's title.
options.risk: The words, the main thing, start below the fold.

options.label: The post as blocks you add and move
options.thesis: The post is a list of blocks (text, a heading, a gallery with its caption, a video, a file), each dragged by its handle or changed from its ⋯ menu, with an Add row of Text, Picture, Video, Audio and File; who, when and telling sit on one row that opens its settings.
options.viewport: Title, then a text block, a heading, a gallery of three with its caption (chosen), a YouTube video, the Add row and Everyone · Notification on · Now.
options.risk: The most to build, and long text is split across blocks rather than written in one go.

options.label: Two steps: write it, then send it
options.thesis: Step 1 is only the words: title, a Write and See it switch, the format bar with Add. Next goes to step 2: who it's for, the notification with a lock-screen preview, and when.
options.viewport: Step 1 of 2: the title, Write chosen, the format bar and the text with its marks, Next at the top right.
options.risk: Two pages to post a quick notice, and the text shows its marks (## and ![…]) while writing.
